title: Checkout charges the last line item at full price
subtitle: services/checkout/total.rb in apply_discounts
body:
A percentage coupon is applied per line item, but the running total is summed *before* the last discount is subtracted.

1. Add three items to a cart.
2. Apply a 10% coupon.
3. The third line is charged at full price.

The accumulator in `apply_discounts` is seeded from the pre-discount subtotal. Fold the discount into each line before summing, not after.

title: Session cookie is not marked SameSite
subtitle: gateway/session.go in issueCookie
body:
`issueCookie` sets `Secure` and `HttpOnly` but omits `SameSite`, so the session rides along on cross-site POSTs.

Set `SameSite=Lax`. The one flow that needs `None` is the embedded widget; give that its own cookie rather than weakening the default.

title: Retry budget is shared across every downstream
subtitle: gateway/rpc/client.go in newClient
body:
One slow downstream exhausts the shared retry budget and starves every other call in the process.

Give each downstream its own budget, keyed by service name.

title: Webhook signature check is timing-dependent
subtitle: webhooks/verify.py in check_signature
body:
`check_signature` compares digests with `==`, which short-circuits on the first differing byte.

Use `hmac.compare_digest`.

title: Invoice PDF renders the wrong currency symbol in de-DE
subtitle: billing/invoice/render.ts in formatMoney
body:
`formatMoney` hardcodes the symbol position, so `de-DE` renders `€1.234,56` as `1.234,56€` with no space.

Use `Intl.NumberFormat` and drop the hand-rolled table.

title: Typo in the onboarding email subject line
subtitle: notifications/templates/welcome.txt
body: "Welcome to you new account" should read "your".
